title: Refunds
text: Customers can request their money back within 30 days of purchase. Approved returns are credited to the original payment method within five business days.

title: Shipping
text: Standard delivery takes three to five working days. Express delivery arrives the next working day when ordered before 2pm.

title: Accounts
text: To reset a password, use the Forgot Password link on the sign-in page. Reset links expire after one hour.

title: Warranty
text: Hardware carries a two year limited warranty covering manufacturing defects but not accidental damage.

title: Cancellation
text: Subscriptions can be cancelled at any time from the billing page and remain active until the end of the paid period.
